
```jsx
import { CxInputGroup } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxInputGroup from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/form/CxInputGroup'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small or large. | `'small'` \| `'large'` \| `undefined` | - |
